meta.name: iterative-code-evolution
meta.description: Systematically improve code through structured analysis-mutation-evaluation loops. Adapted from ALMA (Automated meta-Learning of Memory designs for Agentic systems). Use when iterating on code quality, optimizing implementations, debugging persistent issues, or evolving a design through multiple improvement cycles. Replaces ad-hoc "try and fix" with disciplined reflection, variant tracking, and principled selection of what to change next.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过结构化分析-变异-评估循环系统改进代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多次迭代中系统性地提升代码质量
copy.tagline_en: Systematically improve code through structured analysis-mutation-evaluation loops
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically improve code quality through multiple iteration cycles

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会通过分析、计划、修改、验证、评分和记录六个步骤，系统地改进你的代码。它会记录每次修改的效果，并基于观察结果选择下一步改进方向。
howto.when: 当你需要反复改进代码质量、优化性能、调试顽固问题，或已经尝试过两种以上方法但仍需更系统的方法时触发。

say.text: 帮我改进这个Python脚本，它处理大文件时太慢了。
say.note: Claude会启动分析循环，找出性能瓶颈并逐步优化。

say.text: 这个函数有时会崩溃，帮我系统性地修复它。
say.note: Claude会诊断问题，提出有依据的修改方案。

say.text: 我的网页爬虫只成功了一半的页面，帮我迭代改进。
say.note: Claude会按循环流程逐步提升成功率。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude systematically improves your code through six steps: analyze, plan, mutate, verify, score, and archive. It logs each change's effect and selects the next improvement based on observations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to iteratively improve code quality, optimize performance, debug persistent issues, or have already tried 2+ approaches and need a more disciplined method.

say_en.text: Help me improve this Python script, it's too slow on large files.
This function sometimes crashes, help me fix it systematically.
say_en.note: Claude will diagnose the issue and propose evidence-based changes.

say_en.text: My web scraper only succeeds on half the pages, help me iterate on it.
say_en.note: Claude will follow the evolution cycle to gradually improve success rate.
